description: Agent memory, scratchpad: save a short note between agent runs. Save a short text note (up to 2000 characters) and get back a hard-to-guess id to read it later with note_read, e.g. to hand context between agent runs. Notes are deleted automatically after ttl_days (1 to 7, default 7). No listing or search: only someone with the id can read it. Do not store secrets or personal data. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: note_save
